guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: MBR把生物處理與膜固液分離結合。學徒同時追蹤污泥、需氧、淨產水與膜壓差；膜能截留固體不代表所有溶解物已被破壞。
guides.conceptEn: MBR couples biology with membrane solids separation. Track sludge, oxygen, net production and membrane pressure together; solids retention does not imply destruction of every dissolved substance.
procedure: 先點選「預處理後進料品質」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「高生物量負荷判讀」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把MLVSS降成1.5 kg/m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.2666667 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。與基準 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「污泥齡及排泥」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水固體提高至200 kg/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10 d。與基準 12 d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「生物需氧與膜擦洗分帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把供氧效率降成1.2 kg O₂/kWh，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 kW。與基準 13.33333 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「產水膜列淨通量」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把可用膜面積降成1920 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 50 L/(m²·h)。與基準 40 L/(m²·h)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「跨膜壓差趨勢」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把 TMP升成0.20 bar，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 L/(m²·h·bar)。與基準 200 L/(m²·h·bar)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把每10分鐘抽吸時間降為7分鐘，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 21 L/(m²·h)。與基準 24 L/(m²·h)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「剩餘污泥處置」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把固體分率提高到0.20，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10000 kg/d。與基準 50000 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「水質與壓差感測校驗」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「離線清洗期間可用能力」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the post-pretreatment feed quality measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the high-biomass loading interpretation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only MLVSS to1.5 kg/m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.2666667 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Compare with baseline 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the solids age and wasting measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only effluent solids to200 kg/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10 d. Compare with baseline 12 d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the biological oxygen/membrane scour ledgers measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 kW. Compare with baseline 13.33333 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the membrane-train net flux measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only active membrane area to1920 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 50 L/(m²·h). Compare with baseline 40 L/(m²·h) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the transmembrane-pressure trend measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only TMP to0.20 bar with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 L/(m²·h·bar). Compare with baseline 200 L/(m²·h·bar) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the backwash/relaxation net-production ledger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only suction time to7 of every10 minutes with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 21 L/(m²·h). Compare with baseline 24 L/(m²·h) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the waste-sludge handling measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only solids fraction to0.20 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10000 kg/d. Compare with baseline 50000 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the quality/pressure instrument checks measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the capacity during offline cleaning measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「預處理後進料品質」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
分別量測流量、可生化基質與揮發性固體，再追蹤出水趨勢。在離線場景為「高生物量負荷判讀」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以排泥流量乘固體濃度，並同步估出水SS負荷。在離線場景為「污泥齡及排泥」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
把溶氧、尾氣與電表同步；用一段變負載試驗比較回應。在離線場景為「生物需氧與膜擦洗分帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以產水總表與各膜列面積核對，另記反洗時間。在離線場景為「產水膜列淨通量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
比較相同溫度與流量的前後資料，測壓點須一致。在離線場景為「跨膜壓差趨勢」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用產水總表核對整日淨產水，並區分反洗回流、排放及停機。在離線場景為「反洗鬆弛與淨產水帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「剩餘污泥處置」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「水質與壓差感測校驗」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「離線清洗期間可用能力」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for post-pretreatment feed quality; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Measure flow, biodegradable substrate and volatile solids separately and track effluent trends. Build an offline evidence table for high-biomass loading interpretation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Multiply wasting flow by solids concentration and estimate concurrent effluent SS load. Build an offline evidence table for solids age and wasting; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Synchronize DO, off-gas and power data and compare responses during a changing-load trial. Build an offline evidence table for biological oxygen/membrane scour ledgers; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Reconcile total permeate with each train area and separately log backwash time. Build an offline evidence table for membrane-train net flux; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare before/after data at equal temperature and flow with identical pressure taps. Build an offline evidence table for transmembrane-pressure trend; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Reconcile daily net permeate with a totalizer and distinguish backwash return, disposal and downtime. Build an offline evidence table for backwash/relaxation net-production ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for waste-sludge handling; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for quality/pressure instrument checks; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for capacity during offline cleaning; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
把惰性固體當活性生物量，會低估真正食微比。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
二沉池帶泥會降低污泥齡，不能只調排泥閥猜測。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
未扣停用膜列會低估剩餘膜列的真實通量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
堵塞與水溫下降都會降低比通量，先分離兩種原因。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
用抽吸瞬間通量推算全天產水會高估能力；先重建時間帳。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Counting inert solids as active biomass understates the true F/M. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Clarifier carryover lowers SRT and cannot be diagnosed by wasting settings alone. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Counting offline trains understates flux on the remaining membranes. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Fouling and colder water both lower permeability; distinguish these causes first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Extrapolating instantaneous suction flux over the full day overstates capacity; reconstruct the time ledger. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

history.text: EPA膜生物反應器資料介紹以膜取代傳統固液分離的配置與維護需求；課程採開放機理，不指定膜產品運轉條件。地圖僅標示方法資料來源機構EPA總部的區域參考點，不表示此處設有本課處理廠。
history.textEn: EPA describes membrane-based solids separation and maintenance requirements; this course uses general mechanisms without prescribing product operating conditions. The map marks the EPA headquarters area as a method-source institution, not a treatment plant for this lesson.

courses.connection: MBR把生物處理與膜固液分離結合。學徒同時追蹤污泥、需氧、淨產水與膜壓差；膜能截留固體不代表所有溶解物已被破壞。
courses.connectionEn: MBR couples biology with membrane solids separation. Track sludge, oxygen, net production and membrane pressure together; solids retention does not imply destruction of every dissolved substance.
